_doc: Mimir cracks-brief config (mimir/specs/01-cracks-brief.md). The JUDGMENT lives here: deterministic scoring weights, thresholds, estate/confidence/ownership mapping. Tuning this file needs NO code change — a cheap model may tune the weights. NO LLM ranks items; scoring is pure arithmetic over these numbers. See README.md.

caps._doc: Precision over recall. Total items delivered across all sections, and per-section, are hard-capped. reserve_possibly holds back N of the total slots for top transcript commitments even if high-confidence items would fill the cap (0 = strict spec, high-confidence wins). Bump to 1 during the acceptance test if you want the top 'what did I say I'd do' item to always show. personal_reserved front-loads the top-N personal (by estate) high-confidence items so work tasks can't crowd out every personal crack (0 = no quota).

suppression._doc: Two layers. (1) ops.cracks_dismissed — owner action: plain dismiss hides for dismiss_cooldown_days from dismissed_at; snooze_until hides until that timestamp. (2) resurface hold — AUTOMATIC anti-repetition: an item_key surfaced+delivered in the last resurface_hold_days days is held UNLESS its score rose by >= resurface_score_jump over the max it last surfaced at (so a chronic maxed-out item stops nagging daily, but a genuinely-escalating item still breaks through). resurface_hold_days=0 disables it.

urgency._doc: 0-40 from due date vs run day. days_until<0 means overdue. Long-dead overdue items decay toward 0 (nagging = noise).

staleness._doc: 0-25 from days since last activity. Peaks in the prime crack window (prime_low..prime_high). <fresh_days = still fresh = 0. >abandoned_days = likely abandoned on purpose = abandoned_score.

importance._doc: 0-25 by kind + keyword/assignee/key-people/priority modifiers. Clamped to 25.

actionability._doc: 0-10. Clear one-step resolution still possible vs blocked/awaiting others.

estate._doc: Resolve work|personal per item. Priority: explicit project map -> task_queue domain -> content keywords -> default. Fixes plaud commitments that default to domain=personal but are work content. Project names and keywords below are invented examples; replace with your own.

commitments._doc: Plaud transcript-commitments (medium confidence, gated to 'possibly'). The crack definition = an obligation the OWNER owes. assignee='self' = owner owes it; 'other'/named people = someone else's obligation (drop). 'unknown' kept but ambiguous-owner-penalized.

key_people._doc: STUB — owner fills. Names/emails whose replies-owed bump importance to max. Matched case-insensitively against item text.

tw._doc: TaskWarrior via tw-api :8250 (on worker). Not PG-resident; fetched here. Candidacy = overdue OR (idle>idle_days_threshold AND no scheduled date) OR due within surface_max_days.

delivery._doc: Telegram. actionable=true sends DIRECT via sendMessage with one-tap inline buttons (✅ done / 💤 snooze / 🗑 dismiss per item) — cracks_actions.py polls the bot + writes ops.cracks_dismissed (done also closes the tw task). Requires TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in env; falls back to the notify-only shim if absent. actionable=false = classic shim text. Sections grouped by horizon + a gated 'possibly'.
delivery.empty_message:
🔎 Cracks — {date}

Nothing falling through the cracks today. ✨

phrasing._doc: Optional CHEAP-model natural-language rewrite of the assembled brief. Presentation ONLY — must NOT re-rank, add, or drop items. OFF by default; enable only after v0 precision is trusted. Never a frontier model.
